author: Yffe
content: Kernel-checked pin: lean/Thermite/PinStabilization.lean (Pin B). §4 scopes soundness 'for a DEC-MEASURED registry' (lemma stabilization_exists_for_dec_bounded) but never says who guarantees the hypothesis reaches the exporter. The parser enforces dec PRESENCE only (SpecFnItem::dec mandatory, thermite-syntax/src/ast.rs); dec VALIDITY (the measure decreases) is proven ONLY by Verus — and the Lean rung sits exactly downstream of a Verus Unknown (REQ-3.1 remaps a witness-less failure, incl. a failed spec-fn termination proof, to Unknown → degrade → Lean attempts). Pin: for f(x)=f(x), intVal is CONSTANTLY the bottom 0 (divergent_call_is_const_bottom), so stabilizes HOLDS with the bottom value and 'ens result == f(x)' stabilizes to True at result=0 (divergent_contract_certifies) — the failure mode is silent bottom-poisoned certification, NOT safe unprovability. REQ-7's TERMINATION class covers the item's own loop/recursion (while_rule h_run), not the registry; the conjunction rule assigns no registry-termination class. The exported theorem carries no well-foundedness hypothesis.
